'''Choong Eui Song''' ({{korean|송충의}}; born January 15, 1955) is a South Korean [[organic chemist]].

== Biography ==
Song was born and raised in [[Seoul]]. He received his B.S. degree from [[Chung-Ang University]] in 1980, and received a diploma (1985) and a Ph.D. (1988) at [[RWTH Aachen University]] in Germany.

After completing his Ph.D., he worked as Principal Research Scientist at the [[Korea Institute of Science and Technology]] (KIST). In 2001, he was appointed as a head of the National Research Laboratory for Green Chirotechnology in Korea. In 2004, he moved to [[Sungkyunkwan University]] (Department of Chemistry) as a full professor. In 2005, he was elected as the vice-president of [[Korean Chemical Society]]. From 2006 to 2014 he worked as a director at the Research Institute of Advanced Nanomaterials (University-centered Lab, [[Korea Research Foundation]]). In 2016 he was appointed as a director of National Research Laboratory for Chiral Organic Molecular Materials in Korea.

His research has been focused on [[Enantioselective synthesis#Enantioselective organocatalysis|asymmetric organocatalysis]], [[Biomimetic synthesis|biomimetic catalysis]], [[artificial enzyme]], [[On water reaction|on-water catalysis]] and on-droplet catalysis. His current research also focuses on [[Abiogenesis|prebiotic chemistry]], specifically, the origin of [[homochirality]] (chirality amplification process).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://cesong.skku.edu/|title=Choong Eui Song's Lab homepage}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Choong_Song|title=Choong Eui Song at ResearchGate}}</ref>

== Honors and awards ==

*2000: Scientist of the Month Award, [[Korea Institute of Science and Technology]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kist.re.kr/kist_web_old/?state=view&sub_num=40&idx=-94480|title=The Scientist of the Month Award of KIST|last=KIST|website=www.kist.re.kr|language=ko}}</ref>
*2002: [[Scientist of the Month]], [[Ministry of Science and Technology (South Korea)|Ministry of Science and Technology]]<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://sci.sedaily.com/Winner#60|title=The Scientist of the Month Award of Korea|last=Seoul Economic Daily|language=ko}}</ref> 
*2013: Academic Excellence Grand Prize, [[Korean Chemical Society]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://new.kcsnet.or.kr/branch_organic_notice/14454|title=Academic Excellence Grand Prize|last=Korean Chemical Society|work=대한화학회 |date=9 May 2013 }}</ref>
*2018: Member, [[Korean Academy of Science and Technology]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://kast.or.kr/kr/member/member_view.php?idx=5470|title=Korean Academy of Science and Technology}}</ref>
